name: The Nightmare Prince
source:
The reclusive master of the house, he has not left the gates of his estate since he moved in as a child. The reason he is so reclusive is unknown.

Likes: Art, antiques, poetry, being alone
Dislikes: Exercising, leaving the house, outdoors
